caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar with a lid, centrally placed against a plain, light beige background. The jar is predominantly brown with subtle variations in shading that suggest a glazed finish and the play of light on its surface. It has a rounded, slightly tapering body, a narrower neck, and two small handles on either side of the shoulder. The lid is circular with a small, raised knob in the center. The shadow cast by the jar is soft and minimal, and no other objects or decorations are present. The artist’s signature, "Geo. Lougeridge," is visible in small text near the bottom right of the composition.
title: Covered Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
